usedFor: Shopkit runs online stores, and “New Client” and “New Product” tell you when your store gains one.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Shopkit, then “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo
bestTemplate.why: A new client is pushed to you as it happens, so follow-up can start at once.

watchOut: “Client Updated” and “Product Updated” fire on every change, so expect repeats for one record.
